verdict.rationale: Versioned APIs with a deprecation policy are a fair question to ask of a scraping API service, but the evidence pack never mentions API versioning, version identifiers, changelogs, or a deprecation policy. The cited material covers request parameters, dedicated APIs, a CLI and an MCP server, none of which addresses versioning or deprecation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
